{
  "claim": "AT07's bounded, offline F5 (raw-stream binding) and F6 (event/gate classification) derived repairs are internally consistent and fail-closed on the supplied evidence, but do not prove real worker recovery and do not address F4.",
  "evidence": "local_repair.py hash 272625e3… matches pretest-binding.json and regression capture receipt; test_local_repair.py hash 95ee9865… likewise. Regression subprocess exit_code 0, 9 tests, stderr 'OK', stdout 45 assertion records whose actual==expected throughout, with fixture_kind marking real AT05 replay vs synthetic. Retained AT05 stream binding re-derives stdout 05741d61… and stderr 3885927f… matching worker-execution.json receipt; F5-original-streams-bound=true. F4-provenance.json rows=[] ⇒ INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, preserved in REPAIR-SCOPE.md; AT05 deterministic-validation.json still FAIL, automatic-acceptance C1 NOT PROVEN, C2 PROVEN, P5 UNCERTAIN, P6 YELLOW — unchanged.",
  "verification_method": "Read-only static inspection of file hashes, code paths, fixtures, and bound stdout/stderr as DATA. No tests or commands were executed by this reviewer; execution evidence is the package's own captured regression receipt.",
  "result": "PASS",
  "confidence": 0.72,
  "anomaly_conflict": [
    "F6 unknown/passive event handling: bind-less item types not in ACTION/DIAGNOSTIC/PASSIVE (e.g. mcp_tool_call is in ACTION, but an unrecognized item.type) are classed 'unknown' and only add unknown_events (⇒ UNCERTAIN), not FAIL; a syntactically valid but semantically action-like item would therefore not block, so fail-closed holds only as uncertainty, not failure.",
    "F5 oversized (max_bytes=65536) is checked before hashing/content, so a genuinely large raw stream yields OVERSIZED with no content and no hash-receipt binding, i.e. degraded to 'cannot bind' rather than tamper-detected; consistent with the declared limitation but means completeness is unavailable for large streams.",
    "Safety screen is regex-based on decoded text; a secret spanning the size/encoding boundary or in an unlisted format is not withheld, so 'complete+content' is not a secret-free guarantee (declared, but affects any real use).",
    "Bounded scope inconsistency check: REPAIR-SCOPE.md states gate thresholds '>=0.80/PASS/completed/zero-tools' while review_gate() also FAILs on an empty anomaly_conflict-violating report (anomaly_conflict non-empty ⇒ FAIL), which is stricter than the stated pass rule, not a defect but a divergence between prose and code.",
    "F5 'empty' stream is complete=true while 'not-captured' is complete=false; an empty-but-captured stream is treated as validly bound — consistent with capture semantics, but note empty body cannot be distinguished from a silently suppressed stream absent the captured receipt."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Positive/negative fixtures are explicitly synthetic; only AT05 worker.stdout/stderr and event replay are historical input. No real worker recovery, no live successor integration, no policy engine/sandbox behavior is demonstrated or claimed.",
    "F4 remains unresolved (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, zero matched log rows) and is not repaired; the repair package does not touch it.",
    "Regression exercised only the derived module offline; review_gate()/acceptance() are unit-tested on fixtures, not on live model output.",
    "Trust in the hash bindings depends on the package's own pretest-binding.json/capture receipts; an adversarial producer could not be ruled out from content alone.",
    "No independent per-assertion recomputation was performed by this reviewer; assertions are credited as reported evidence.",
    "Scope checks (scope_by_action) are deterministic test inputs, not a command policy decision."
  ],
  "repair_results": {
    "F5": "PASS",
    "F6": "PASS"
  }
}
